units.source_text: 话音刚落，狗店老板拽住小狗颈圈的手立即松开，

en.t: As soon as the words were spoken, the dog shop owner immediately let go of the hand gripping the puppy's collar,

units.source_text: 小宠犬蓦地从长沙发上蹦下来，

en.t: and the little pet dog suddenly sprang down from the long sofa,
about to pounce toward the mother dog.
